basic_info.description:
First time on the market since 1938. This home is nestled and pictured in San Francisco site describing the Liberty Hill historic district is located in the Dolores Heights neighborhood. A neighborhood bound by 20th Street, Mission, Dolores and 22nd Street.
Upon walkup open the front door and enter a peaceful sanctuary walking down a hall with original floors and wainscot passing a master bedroom with sliding doors opening to the living room with a very inviting fireplace still passing two more bedrooms, dining room, a bright and sunny eat-in kitchen and finally to the private rear patio and garden.This home featuring approximately 1520 sqft of living area including three bedrooms and one bath a large basement with washer/dryer and storage area.
No seller financing. Subject to a 1030 exchange.
Being sold in "as is" condition.
